# Finite State

> Finite State is an autonomous product security OS that automates the security lifecycle for connected devices across automotive, medical, industrial, energy, and government sectors.

Finite State provides AI-powered security automation through its Alloy engine, enabling organizations to achieve compliance with regulations like EU CRA, FDA §524B, ISO/SAE 21434, NERC CIP, and IEC 62443. The platform combines SBOM generation, vulnerability prioritization, threat modeling, and compliance evidence automation to reduce security risk across product development and supply chains.

## Key Topics

- SBOM (Software Bill of Materials)
- Vulnerability Management
- Firmware Analysis
- Compliance Automation
- Supply Chain Security
- Product Security Automation
- Alloy Engine
- Threat Modeling
- Vulnerability Prioritization
- ISO/SAE 21434
- FDA §524B
- EU CRA Compliance
- NERC CIP
- IEC 62443
- Assurance Studio

## Platform Overview

- [Finite State Platform](https://finitestate.io/platform): AI-powered product security platform with Alloy engine for code and firmware analysis.
- [Finite State Home](https://finitestate.io): Autonomous Product Security OS for Connected Devices - automates the entire product security lifecycle.

## Core Security Capabilities

- [Ground Truth Inventory](https://finitestate.io/platform/ground-truth-inventory): SBOM generation and software inventory management for compliance automation.
- [Exploitability-Based Vulnerability Prioritization](https://finitestate.io/platform/exploitability-based-prioritization): Vulnerability prioritization via reachability analysis, KEV, and EPSS scoring.
- [Design-Time Architecture Security](https://finitestate.io/platform/design-time-architecture-security): Threat modeling and architecture security validation with Assurance Studio.
- [Automated Evidence-Backed Compliance](https://finitestate.io/platform/automated-evidence-backed-compliance): Audit-ready compliance evidence generation for EU CRA, FDA §524B, and CE RED regulations.

## Industry Solutions

- [Connected Device Manufacturers](https://finitestate.io/industry/connected-device-manufacturers): Device manufacturer solutions for EU CRA, UK PSTI, and NIST IoT compliance.
- [Automotive & Connected Vehicles](https://finitestate.io/industry/connected-vehicles): Automotive cybersecurity platform for ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE WP.29 compliance.
- [Medical Devices](https://finitestate.io/industry/medical-devices): Medical device security platform with FDA §524B compliance automation.
- [Energy & Utilities](https://finitestate.io/industry/energy-utilities): OT/ICS security solutions with SBOM management and NERC CIP compliance.
- [Industrial Control Systems](https://finitestate.io/industry/industrial): Industrial ICS security with IEC 62443 and NIS2 compliance for PLC/SCADA environments.
- [Federal & Government](https://finitestate.io/industry/government): Federal supply chain security solutions for Executive Order 14028 and FISMA compliance.
